meta.name: landing-page-creator
meta.description: Build high-converting affiliate landing pages as single self-contained HTML files. Triggers on: "create a landing page for", "build a landing page", "product landing page", "affiliate landing page", "comparison page for", "vs page", "single product page", "conversion page", "sales page for affiliate", "landing page HTML", "build me a page for", "create a page to promote [product]", "I need a landing page", "make a page for [product]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成高转化率的独立营销页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速创建单个HTML营销页面来推广产品。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a single HTML marketing page to promote products.

howto.what: 构建联盟营销着陆页，生成单个自包含HTML文件。可创建单产品页或多产品对比页，无需外部资源，移动端自适应。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建着陆页、销售页、产品页、对比页等，或说出“create a landing page for”等触发词时。

say.note: 自动使用默认蓝色主题和单产品类型

say.text: 用深色主题为Semrush建个页面

howto.what_en: Builds affiliate landing pages as single self-contained HTML files. Can create single product spotlight or multi-product comparison pages. No external dependencies, mobile-responsive, deployable anywhere.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to create a landing page, sales page, product page, comparison page, or uses phrases like "create a landing page for", "build a landing page", etc.

say_en.text: Create a landing page for HeyGen
say_en.note: Default single product with blue theme
